title: Special repairs and maintenance work of Lighthouse Tower & Visitor Toilet at Dolphin Nose Lighthouse cum DGPS Station along with external painting of Staff Quarters, Retaining Wall, Inspection Quarter and miscellaneous improvement works in the station.
summary: Percentage-rate e-tender for special repairs and maintenance of the lighthouse tower and visitor toilet, external painting of staff quarters, retaining wall and inspection quarter, and miscellaneous improvements at Dolphin Nose Lighthouse cum DGPS Station, Yarada Hill, Visakhapatnam.

procurement.issuing_office: Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Visakhapatnam

sites.name: Dolphin Nose Lighthouse cum DGPS Station, Yarada Hill, Visakhapatnam 530005
sites.work: Special repairs to lighthouse tower and visitor toilet; external painting of staff quarters, retaining wall, inspection quarter; miscellaneous improvement works

scope.item: Special repairs and maintenance of Lighthouse Tower & Visitor Toilet
External painting of Staff Quarters, Retaining Wall, Inspection Quarter
Miscellaneous improvement works in the station

money.notes: Estimated cost including GST and all other taxes. Percentage rate tender, two cover system. EMD by DD/FDR of any scheduled bank in favour of Director of Lighthouses and Lightships, Visakhapatnam, valid four months from technical bid opening (Hindi text of clause 1.2 says three months). EMD not exempted for any bidder (including NSIC/MSME) and forfeited if timelines not followed. Tender fee nil.

period.bid_validity: 90 days from the date of opening of tender

eligibility: Valid registration in appropriate category & class with Central Govt/CPWD/State Govt/Railways/MES/BSNL/PSU
Similar works satisfactorily completed in last seven years: three each >= 40%, or two each >= 50%, or one >= 80% of estimated cost; values updated at 7% p.a.; completion certificates required
Similar works: construction/maintenance works of buildings and other civil structures
PAN and GST registration; key technical personnel; unconditional tender undertaking (Annexure V); tender acceptance letter (Annexure IV)
Not-blacklisted affidavit; ITR for FY 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25; list of relatives serving in MoPSW/DGLL
Average annual turnover of last three financial years minimum 30% of estimated cost
Activity chart/plan, self-assessed technical evaluation sheet, valid labour licence or self-declaration, bank mandate form with cancelled cheque
notes: NIT dated 29/11/2025; pages 3-7 of a 102-page tender document (Section I only; no BOQ). Bid download/submission 29/11/2025 12:00 to 09/12/2025 18:00; EMD original up to 09/12/2025 18:00; opening 10/12/2025 12:00. Heavy vehicles permitted to work site. Office e-mail dte-visha@nic.in.
